Return (True, core) or (False, reason). Mirror `verify_approval`.\n- `RECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"`. `record_receipt(store, core) -> int`: append `kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\", payload={\"signal\":RECEIPT_SIGNAL,\"device\":core[\"device\"],\"action\":core[\"action\"],\"nonce\":core[\"nonce\"],\"ts\":core[\"ts\"],\"tier\":\"A0\",\"decision\":\"auto\"}`.\n- `device_nonce_highwater(store, device_pubkey) -> int`: scan `store.iter_records()` for RECEIPT_SIGNAL records with matching device; return the max int(nonce) (default 0); tolerate non-int nonces.\n- `consume(store, payload, authorized, *, effectful: bool) -> dict`: `ok, core = verify_envelope(...)`; if not ok raise `ValueError(core)`; if effectful require `int(core[\"nonce\"]) > device_nonce_highwater(store, core[\"device\"])` else raise `ValueError(\"replay: nonce not fresh\")`; then `record_receipt(store, core)`; return core.\n- CRITICAL: envelope.py must be PURE — NO wallclock, NO `Date`, NO random. The nonce and ts are supplied by the caller. (Timestamp-window freshness lives in the server layer, not here.)\n\nTESTS (`tests/test_bridge_envelope.py`, mirror `tests/test_mobile.py` structure + the `__main__` runner):\n- authorize a device (mesh.authorize_device with an OWNER keypair), compute `authorized = authorized_devices(store, OWNER.public_key_b64)`.\n- a well-formed signed envelope verifies (ok True, core returned); a foreign/unauthorized key → ok False.\n- `consume(effectful=True)` with nonce=1 succeeds, a second nonce=1 raises replay, nonce=2 succeeds.\n- a tampered `action` (mutate after signing) → verify False.\n- a revoked device (mesh.revoke_device) → dropped from authorized → verify/consume refused.\n- a fixed-vector parity assertion: `envelope_message(<fixed core>)` equals a hardcoded expected byte string (document the exact bytes in a comment — the future JS client must reproduce them).\n\nVERIFY: run `~/.sigil/venv/bin/python tests/test_bridge_envelope.py` (must be all-pass) AND run the FULL suite loop `for t in tests/test_*.py; do ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python \"$t\" 2>&1 | tail -1; done` to confirm you broke nothing. {"parentUuid":"1f9627d0-10d3-4533-9d6a-ceba6e53bfb8","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"ae3f64939885fb2f2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DuxDbDCpKxvyQMFZSGpxZs","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Approval queue (SIGIL §5, §9.3 mobile bridge) — the human gate for A2/A3 proposals. An agent\n2\tQUEUES a proposal (governor → QUEUE); the owner APPROVES or DENIES it here. Authentication is an\n3\tEd25519 signature over the canonical (target, decision, approver) by the OWNER key.\n4\t\n5\tRED-PEN HARDENING (Phase 6):\n6\t • The trusted pubkey is the PERSISTED owner identity — NOT the key supplied to the queue, so an\n7\t   attacker cannot self-certify by bringing their own key (RP-APPROVAL-2). approve/deny require the\n8\t   supplied signing key to BE the trusted owner key.\n9\t • `pending()` treats a queued item as resolved ONLY when a superseding approval VERIFIES against the\n10\t   trusted owner key, and keys resolution off the SIGNED target_seq (not the raw supersedes_id) — so\n11\t   an unsigned/forged approval can't silently drop an item (RP-1/RP-APPROVAL-1), and a genuine\n12\t   approval of one item can't be replayed onto another (RP-APPROVAL-4). `verify_approval` is thereby\n13\t   on the enforcement path (RP-APPROVAL-3).\n14\t\n15\tThis records the DECISION; it executes no external effect (SIGIL has no send/deploy path). The\n16\ttransport (Telegram/WhatsApp over WireGuard, §9.3) is a seam over this authenticated core.\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sha256_hex, sign, verify_one\n22\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n23\t\n24\tSIGNAL = \"governor.approval\"\n25\t_QUEUED_STATUS = \"awaiting-approval\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _approval_message(target_seq, decision: str, approver: str) -> bytes:\n29\t    m = canonical_json({\"target\": target_seq, \"decision\": decision, \"approver\": approver})\n30\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef verify_approval(record, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str], *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> bool:\n34\t    \"\"\"True iff the approval carries a valid signature over its (target, decision, approver) by the\n35\t    OWNER key OR by a currently-authorized DEVICE key (`extra_pubkeys`). The claimed `pubkey` must be\n36\t    in the allowed set — which is composed ONLY of owner-minted keys (the owner identity + the\n37\t    owner-signed device-authorization ledger, see `sigil.mesh`) — so a key the requester merely\n38\t    presents is never trusted (RP-APPROVAL-2). The signed `target_seq` still binds (RP-APPROVAL-4).\n39\t    Unsigned / not-in-allowed-set / no-trusted-key → False (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n40\t    p = record.payload if hasattr(record, \"payload\") else record\n41\t    sig, pub = p.get(\"sig\"), p.get(\"pubkey\")\n42\t    allowed = set()\n43\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64:\n44\t        allowed.add(trusted_pubkey_b64)\n45\t    if extra_pubkeys:\n46\t        allowed.update(extra_pubkeys)\n47\t    if not sig or not pub or pub not in allowed:\n48\t        return False\n49\t    msg = _approval_message(p.get(\"target_seq\"), p.get(\"approval\"), p.get(\"approver\"))\n50\t    return verify_one(pub, msg, sig)                # verify against the (owner-minted) claimed key\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef pending(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None, *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> List:\n54\t    \"\"\"Queued proposals with NO valid approval yet, oldest first. Resolution requires a VERIFIED\n55\t    owner/authorized-device approval; an unsigned/forged/unauthorized approval leaves the item\n56\t    pending (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n57\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64 is None:\n58\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n59\t        trusted_pubkey_b64 = owner_pubkey()\n60\t    resolved = set()\n61\t    queued = {}\n62\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n63\t        p = r.payload\n64\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == SIGNAL and verify_approval(r, trusted_pubkey_b64, extra_pubkeys=extra_pubkeys):\n65\t            resolved.add(p.get(\"target_seq\"))       # honor the SIGNED target, not raw supersedes_id\n66\t        if p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == _QUEUED_STATUS:\n67\t            queued[r.seq] = r\n68\t    return [r for seq, r in sorted(queued.items()) if seq not in resolved]\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tclass ApprovalError(Exception):\n72\t    pass\n73\t\n74\t\n75\tclass ApprovalQueue:\n76\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, owner_key=None,\n77\t                 trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None):\n78\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n79\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n80\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n81\t        # PINNED to the persisted owner identity — never defaulted to the supplied key (RP-APPROVAL-2)\n82\t        self.trusted_pubkey_b64 = trusted_pubkey_b64 if trusted_pubkey_b64 is not None else owner_pubkey()\n83\t\n84\t    def _target(self, seq: int):\n85\t        for r in pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n86\t            if r.seq == seq:\n87\t                return r\n88\t        raise ApprovalError(f\"seq {seq} is not a pending approval (already decided, or not queued)\")\n89\t\n90\t    def _decide(self, seq: int, decision: str, *, approver: str, reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n91\t        target = self._target(seq)\n92\t        # the signing key MUST be the trusted owner key — not merely \"some key present\" (RP-APPROVAL-2).\n93\t        if (self.owner_key is None or self.trusted_pubkey_b64 is None\n94\t                or self.owner_key.public_key_b64 != self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n95\t            raise ApprovalError(\"approval requires the OWNER's signing key (missing or not the trusted key)\")\n96\t        msg = _approval_message(seq, decision, approver)\n97\t        sig = sign(self.owner_key.private_key_b64, msg)\n98\t        payload = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": seq, \"target_kind\": target.kind,\n99\t                   \"target_tier\": target.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"approver\": approver, \"reason\": reason,\n100\t                   \"pubkey\": self.trusted_pubkey_b64, \"sig\": sig, \"msg_digest\": sha256_hex(msg),\n101\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n102\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n103\t                                 payload=payload, supersedes_id=seq)\n104\t\n105\t    def approve(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n106\t        return self._decide(seq, \"approved\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n107\t\n108\t    def deny(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n109\t        return self._decide(seq, \"denied\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n110\t"}]},"uuid":"23c02f89-5b49-453c-a90e-21909e97bbe0","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:19.950Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1f9627d0-10d3-4533-9d6a-ceba6e53bfb8","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae3f64939885fb2f2","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

import owner_pubkey\n21\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex, sign\n22\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n23\t\n24\tCAP_SIGNAL = \"mesh.host_capability\"\n25\tDEV_SIGNAL = \"mesh.device\"\n26\t_CAP_CORE = (\"signal\", \"host_id\", \"os\", \"has_screen\", \"has_camera\", \"has_gpu_vlm\", \"always_on\",\n27\t             \"has_hid_inject\", \"has_camera_stream\")\n28\t_DEV_CORE = (\"signal\", \"state\", \"device_id\", \"device_pubkey\")\n29\t\n30\t\n31\t# --- host capability advertisement -----------------------------------------------------------------\n32\tdef advertise_capability(store: SpineStore, descriptor: dict, owner_key) -> int:\n33\t    core = {\"signal\": CAP_SIGNAL, \"host_id\": descriptor[\"host_id\"], \"os\": descriptor[\"os\"],\n34\t            \"has_screen\": bool(descriptor[\"has_screen\"]), \"has_camera\": bool(descriptor[\"has_camera\"]),\n35\t            \"has_gpu_vlm\": bool(descriptor[\"has_gpu_vlm\"]), \"always_on\": bool(descriptor[\"always_on\"]),\n36\t            \"has_hid_inject\": bool(descriptor.get(\"has_hid_inject\", False)),\n37\t            \"has_camera_stream\": bool(descriptor.get(\"has_camera_stream\", False))}\n38\t    payload = {**signed_payload(core, owner_key), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n39\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tdef capability_map(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:\n43\t    \"\"\"Latest VERIFIED capability per host_id (forged/unsigned advertisements ignored).\"\"\"\n44\t    tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n45\t    latest: dict = {}\n46\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n47\t        p = r.payload\n48\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == CAP_SIGNAL and verify_signed(p, _CAP_CORE, tp):\n49\t            latest[p.get(\"host_id\")] = {k: p.get(k) for k in _CAP_CORE if k != \"signal\"}\n50\t    return latest\n51\t\n52\t\n53\t# --- device authorization ledger -------------------------------------------------------------------\n54\tdef authorize_device(store: SpineStore, device_id: str, device_pubkey: str, owner_key) -> int:\n55\t    core = {\"signal\": DEV_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"authorized\", \"device_id\": device_id, \"device_pubkey\": device_pubkey}\n56\t    payload = {**signed_payload(core, owner_key), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n57\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n58\t\n59\t\n60\tdef revoke_device(store: SpineStore, device_id: str, device_pubkey: str, owner_key) -> int:\n61\t    core = {\"signal\": DEV_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"revoked\", \"device_id\": device_id, \"device_pubkey\": device_pubkey}\n62\t    payload = {**signed_payload(core, owner_key), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n63\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"OWNER\", payload=payload)\n64\t\n65\t\n66\tdef authorized_devices(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None) -> Set[str]:\n67\t    \"\"\"The set of currently-authorized device pubkeys (owner-signed authorize, minus later revoke).\n68\t    An unsigned/forged authorization is ignored — a rogue device cannot self-authorize.\"\"\"\n69\t    tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n70\t    state: dict = {}\n71\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n72\t        p = r.payload\n73\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == DEV_SIGNAL and p.get(\"state\") in (\"authorized\", \"revoked\") \\\n74\t                and verify_signed(p, _DEV_CORE, tp):\n75\t            state[p.get(\"device_pubkey\")] = p[\"state\"]      # latest verified state per device key\n76\t    return {pub for pub, st in state.items() if st == \"authorized\"}\n77\t\n78\t\n79\tclass DeviceApprover:\n80\t    \"\"\"Signs an approval with a DEVICE key (the phone). The record verifies via\n81\t    `verify_approval(record, owner_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=authorized_devices(store))` — i.e. only while\n82\t    the device remains authorized. Never touches the owner trust-root key.\"\"\"\n83\t    def __init__(self, store: SpineStore, *, device_key):\n84\t        self.store = store\n85\t        self.device_key = device_key\n86\t\n87\t    def _decide(self, seq: int, decision: str, approver: str, reason: str) -> int:\n88\t        msg = _approval_message(seq, decision, approver)\n89\t        sig = sign(self.device_key.private_key_b64, msg)\n90\t        payload = {\"signal\": _APPROVAL_SIGNAL, \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": seq,\n91\t                   \"approver\": approver, \"reason\": reason, \"pubkey\": self.device_key.public_key_b64,\n92\t                   \"sig\": sig, \"msg_digest\": sha256_hex(msg), \"device\": True, \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n93\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\", payload=payload, supersedes_id=seq)\n94\t\n95\t    def approve(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"device\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n96\t        return self._decide(seq, \"approved\", approver, reason)\n97\t\n98\t    def deny(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"device\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n99\t        return self._decide(seq, \"denied\", approver, reason)\n100\t"}]},"uuid":"912b7439-f1a7-4ced-b3ce-18d6b4a36b3f","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:24.202Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"75c2cab0-6ab5-48c5-bcb4-7049d94a5138","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae3f64939885fb2f2","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

It\n2\treuses the owner-signed cores: the queue (`approvals.pending` with the authorized-device set), a\n3\tDEVICE-signed approval (accepted only while that device is authorized), a PANIC halt (any engage is\n4\tfail-safe), and a KERNEL command relay (`KernelDispatch` → the same WARDEN gate as voice/UI).\n5\t\n6\tThis module is the bridge LIBRARY CORE + API (the doctrine + crypto). The network TRANSPORT — an\n7\tHTTP server over WireGuard, reusing the WS-C two-plane server pattern bound to a `bind_ok` address —\n8\tis a documented NEXT slice, not shipped here. `bind_ok` is the bind predicate that transport MUST\n9\tuse: loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) address only — NEVER 0.0.0.0 / a public address.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport ipaddress\n13\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tdef bind_ok(addr: str) -> bool:\n19\t    \"\"\"True iff `addr` is safe to bind: loopback or a PRIVATE (e.g. WireGuard) address — never\n20\t    0.0.0.0 / a public / an unspecified address.\"\"\"\n21\t    try:\n22\t        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(addr)\n23\t    except ValueError:\n24\t        return False\n25\t    if ip.is_unspecified:                          # 0.0.0.0 / :: → refuse\n26\t        return False\n27\t    return ip.is_loopback or ip.is_private\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tclass BridgeDaemon:\n31\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n32\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n33\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n34\t        # A rogue/revoked device or a\n50\t        forged signature is refused; the signed target_seq binds (no replay).\"\"\"\n51\t        from ..agents.approvals import SIGNAL as APPROVAL_SIGNAL\n52\t        from ..agents.approvals import verify_approval\n53\t\n54\t        class _Rec:\n55\t            def __init__(self, p): self.payload = p\n56\t        authorized = self._authorized()\n57\t        if payload.get(\"signal\") != APPROVAL_SIGNAL:\n58\t            raise ValueError(\"not an approval record\")\n59\t        if payload.get(\"pubkey\") not in authorized:\n60\t            raise ValueError(\"signing device is not authorized\")\n61\t        if not verify_approval(_Rec(payload), self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=authorized):\n62\t            raise ValueError(\"approval signature invalid\")\n63\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n64\t                                 payload={**payload, \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n65\t                                 supersedes_id=payload.get(\"target_seq\"))\n66\t\n67\t    def panic_engage(self, *, by: str = \"phone\") -> int:\n68\t        \"\"\"Halt the mesh from the phone. ANY engage halts (fail-safe) — no signature needed for the\n69\t        SAFE direction. {"parentUuid":"127a1d67-ce54-4d3b-bdf0-eeed617654c6","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"48b12788-c981-47f3-b65f-5777062df810","agentId":"ae3f64939885fb2f2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MsSmk5pC6UMdcN92w3iADB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Append-only, hash-chained JSONL spine (SIGIL §6.1, D1).\n2\t\n3\tReuses CRUCIBLE's tamper-evident chain verbatim (`sigil.reuse`): each line carries\n4\t`{seq, prev_hash, entry_hash}` where `entry_hash` links prev+cert_digest+seq. The\n5\t`cert_digest` is over the record's CONTENT only (scope/kind/source/actor/payload/\n6\tparent/supersedes) — NOT the wallclock `ts` — so the chain is replay-stable. Appends\n7\tare O(1): read the last line's entry, `append_entry`, write.\n8\t\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport json\n12\timport os\n13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n14\tfrom typing import Any, Iterator\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..config import SCOPE, SPINE_PATH\n17\tfrom ..reuse import ChainEntry, append_entry, build_chain, digest_payload, verify_chain\n18\tfrom .models import SpineRecord, now_iso\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef _last_nonempty_line(path: Path) -> str | None:\n22\t    \"\"\"Read the last non-empty line without loading the file (seek-from-end).\"\"\"\n23\t    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n24\t        f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n25\t        end = f.tell()\n26\t        if end == 0:\n27\t            return None\n28\t        buf = b\"\"\n29\t        pos = end\n30\t        while pos > 0:\n31\t            step = min(8192, pos)\n32\t            pos -= step\n33\t            f.seek(pos)\n34\t            buf = f.read(step) + buf\n35\t            lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n36\t            if lines and (pos == 0 or buf.count(b\"\\n\") >= 2):\n37\t                return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\")\n38\t        lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n39\t        return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\") if lines else None\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tclass SpineStore:\n43\t    def __init__(self, path: Path | str = SPINE_PATH) -> None:\n44\t        self.path = Path(path)\n45\t        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n46\t        self._last: ChainEntry | None = self._read_last_entry()\n47\t\n48\t    # --- write --------------------------------------------------------------------\n49\t    def append(\n50\t        self, *, kind: str, source: str, actor: str, payload: dict[str, Any],\n51\t        parent_id: int | None = None, supersedes_id: int | None = None,\n52\t        ts: str | None = None,\n53\t    ) -> int:\n54\t        content = {\n55\t            \"scope\": SCOPE, \"kind\": kind, \"source\": source, \"actor\": actor,\n56\t            \"payload\": payload, \"parent_id\": parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": supersedes_id,\n57\t        }\n58\t        cert_digest = digest_payload(content)  # wallclock-free\n59\t        entry = append_entry([self._last], cert_digest) if self._last else build_chain([cert_digest])[0]\n60\t        record = {\n61\t            \"seq\": entry.seq, **content, \"ts\": ts or now_iso(),\n62\t            \"cert_digest\": cert_digest, \"prev_hash\": entry.prev_hash, \"entry_hash\": entry.entry_hash,\n63\t        }\n64\t        with self.path.open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n65\t            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n66\t        self._last = entry\n67\t        return entry.seq\n68\t\n69\t    # --- read ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n70\t    def iter_records(self, *, since_seq: int = -1) -> Iterator[SpineRecord]:\n71\t        if not self.path.exists():\n72\t            return\n73\t        with self.path.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n74\t            for line in f:\n75\t                line = line.strip()\n76\t                if not line:\n77\t                    continue\n78\t                d = json.loads(line)\n79\t                if d[\"seq\"] > since_seq:\n80\t                    yield SpineRecord.from_dict(d)\n81\t\n82\t    def get(self, seq: int) -> SpineRecord | None:\n83\t        for r in self.iter_records(since_seq=seq - 1):\n84\t            if r.seq == seq:\n85\t                return r\n86\t            if r.seq > seq:\n87\t                break\n88\t        return None\n89\t\n90\t    @property\n91\t    def next_seq(self) -> int:\n92\t        return (self._last.seq + 1) if self._last else 0\n93\t\n94\t    def count(self) -> int:\n95\t        return sum(1 for _ in self.iter_records())\n96\t\n97\t    # --- integrity ----------------------------------------------------------------\n98\t    def entries(self) -> list[ChainEntry]:\n99\t        return [\n100\t            ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash)\n101\t            for r in self.iter_records()\n102\t        ]\n103\t\n104\t    def verify(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n105\t        \"\"\"Two-layer UNKEYED integrity: (1) BINDING — each record's payload still hashes to its\n106\t        stored cert_digest (catches silent payload edits); (2) CHAIN — the entries link cleanly\n107\t        (catches delete/reorder/entry tamper). This proves internal CONSISTENCY, not authenticity:\n108\t        a naive payload edit fails (1), and a mid-chain digest edit cascades an entry_hash/prev_hash\n109\t        break caught by (2) — BUT a writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash for the tip (no\n110\t        successor to cascade into) or forward-cascades a fork produces a self-consistent chain that\n111\t        passes here. Resistance to a recompute-capable writer is the owner-SIGNED head's job\n112\t        (`checkpoint.verify_checkpoint`, Ed25519 + monotonic last_seq). Use this for corruption/\n113\t        naive-tamper detection; use the signed head for tamper-EVIDENCE.\"\"\"\n114\t        entries: list[ChainEntry] = []\n115\t        for r in self.iter_records():\n116\t            content = {\n117\t                \"scope\": r.scope, \"kind\": r.kind, \"source\": r.source, \"actor\": r.actor,\n118\t                \"payload\": r.payload, \"parent_id\": r.parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": r.supersedes_id,\n119\t            }\n120\t            if digest_payload(content) != r.cert_digest:\n121\t                return False, f\"binding break at seq {r.seq}: payload does not match cert_digest (record tampered)\"\n122\t            entries.append(ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash))\n123\t        return verify_chain(entries)\n124\t\n125\t    def _read_last_entry(self) -> ChainEntry | None:\n126\t        line = _last_nonempty_line(self.path) if self.path.exists() else None\n127\t        if not line:\n128\t            return None\n129\t        d = json.loads(line)\n130\t        return ChainEntry(seq=d[\"seq\"], prev_hash=d[\"prev_hash\"], cert_digest=d[\"cert_digest\"], entry_hash=d[\"entry_hash\"])\n131\t"}]},"uuid":"ee5379b1-93c2-47bb-b096-6969c7fcfb88","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:30.518Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"127a1d67-ce54-4d3b-bdf0-eeed617654c6","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae3f64939885fb2f2","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Behaviour is byte-identical.\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport hashlib\n10\timport json\n11\tfrom typing import Any, Final\n12\t\n13\t# Never change without a schema bump + migration (invalidates all existing signatures).\n14\t_EVIDENCE_DOMAIN: Final[bytes] = b\"crucible-evidence-v1\\x00\"\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef canonical_json(payload: Any) -> bytes:\n18\t    \"\"\"Deterministic UTF-8 JSON: sorted keys (recursive), compact separators.\"\"\"\n19\t    return json.dumps(\n20\t        payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=False,\n21\t    ).encode(\"utf-8\")\n22\t\n23\t\n24\tdef sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:\n25\t    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef digest_payload(payload: Any) -> str:\n29\t    \"\"\"sha256 of a JSON-serialisable payload in canonical form.\"\"\"\n30\t    return sha256_hex(canonical_json(payload))\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef evidence_signing_bytes(certificate_payload: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:\n34\t    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified (canonical JSON under the domain tag).\"\"\"\n35\t    return _EVIDENCE_DOMAIN + canonical_json(certificate_payload)\n36\t"}]},"uuid":"e27bbe6a-ed66-4baf-a8e1-17b1ed0b7a58","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:30:35.325Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7b20179b-7792-4e4e-bce7-70f6d0268bba","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae3f64939885fb2f2","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Signing helpers are\n5\tprovisioning-only; the runtime only ever verifies. The sole change from the source is a\n6\tlocal `IntegrityError` in place of the framework's `EntitlementError` (decoupling).\n7\t\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport base64\n11\timport binascii\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n13\t\n14\tfrom cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature\n15\tfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import (\n16\t    Ed25519PrivateKey,\n17\t    Ed25519PublicKey,\n18\t)\n19\tfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import (\n20\t    Encoding,\n21\t    NoEncryption,\n22\t    PrivateFormat,\n23\t    PublicFormat,\n24\t)\n25\t\n26\tfrom .models import AuthorizerKey, Signature, TrustRoot\n27\t\n28\t\n29\tclass IntegrityError(Exception):\n30\t    \"\"\"Malformed key/signature material (a provisioning error, not an attacker path).\"\"\"\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef _b64decode_exact(value: str, expected_len: int, what: str) -> bytes:\n34\t    try:\n35\t        raw = base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)\n36\t    except (ValueError, binascii.Error) as e:\n37\t        raise IntegrityError(f\"{what} is not valid base64: {e}\") from e\n38\t    if len(raw) != expected_len:\n39\t        raise IntegrityError(f\"{what} decodes to {len(raw)} bytes, expected {expected_len}\")\n40\t    return raw\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef load_public_key(public_key_b64: str) -> Ed25519PublicKey:\n44\t    return Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(_b64decode_exact(public_key_b64, 32, \"Ed25519 public key\"))\n45\t\n46\t\n47\tdef verify_one(public_key_b64: str, message: bytes, signature_b64: str) -> bool:\n48\t    \"\"\"True iff a valid Ed25519 signature; False on bad sig; raises only on malformed material.\"\"\"\n49\t    pub = load_public_key(public_key_b64)\n50\t    sig = {"parentUuid":"8910875d-f0d4-4e78-8f36-9894142af8c0","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"ae3f64939885fb2f2","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAPo9JdKT3ekqfFmKbRh","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EzD9TmGiU9RE5sJPRJAzC7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/sigil/bridge/envelope.py","content":"\"\"\"Device-signed, replay-resistant request envelope (Phase 9 W1-A) — the bridge auth keystone.\n\nThe phone (a device the owner AUTHORIZED via `sigil.mesh.authorize_device`) signs EACH request to the\ndesktop bridge with ITS OWN Ed25519 key over the canonical envelope core. There is NO wire bearer\nsecret: authentication IS the signature, verified against the owner-minted authorized-device set. This\nmirrors the approval-record pattern (`agents.approvals._approval_message` / `verify_approval`) — same\ncanonical-JSON message, same fail-closed `verify_one`, same trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n(a rogue/revoked device cannot self-authorize; a tampered field breaks the signature).\n\nReplay resistance is a deterministic, spine-anchored monotonic-nonce highwater PER DEVICE: an effectful\nrequest must carry a nonce strictly greater than the highest nonce that device has ever been receipted\nfor. Reads still receipt (advancing the watermark) but skip the freshness gate (they have no side\neffect). The receipt is an append-only spine event, so the watermark is tamper-evident memory.\n\nThis module is PURE by construction — NO wallclock, NO RNG. The caller supplies `nonce` and `ts` so the\nJS phone client and Python reproduce the exact signed bytes (the parity contract) and so freshness is a\ndeterministic function of the spine. A wallclock timestamp-WINDOW check (is `ts` recent?) belongs to\nthe server transport layer, not here. Offense-free.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Set, Tuple, Union\n\nfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\nfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n\n# The request vocabulary the bridge accepts — a fail-closed allow-list. `panic`/`relay` are effectful;\n# the `read:*` family is side-effect-free. An action outside this set is refused even if validly signed.\nACTIONS = frozenset({\"panic\", \"relay\", \"read:snapshot\", \"read:pending\", \"read:record\",\n                     \"read:stream\", \"read:recall\"})\n\n# The spine signal marking a consumed request. Its records form the per-device nonce highwater.\nRECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"\n\n\ndef envelope_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified — canonical JSON of the core. This is the JS<->Python parity\n    contract: a future JS client MUST produce these identical bytes. Mirrors\n    `agents.approvals._approval_message` (return bytes; encode only if `canonical_json` gave a str).\"\"\"\n    m = canonical_json(core)\n    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n\n\ndef build_core(device_pubkey: str, action: str, args: dict, nonce, ts) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The signed core. `nonce`/`ts` are caller-supplied (this module never reads a clock or RNG).\"\"\"\n    return {\"v\": 1, \"device\": device_pubkey, \"action\": action, \"args\": args, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts}\n\n\ndef sign_envelope(device_key, core: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Phone/test side: attach a DEVICE signature over the canonical core, producing the wire payload.\"\"\"\n    return {**core, \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, envelope_message(core))}\n\n\ndef verify_envelope(payload, authorized: Set[str]) -> Tuple[bool, Union[dict, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Fail-closed authentication. Rebuild the core (payload minus `sig`); refuse if there is no sig /\n    no device / the device is not in the owner-minted authorized set; then Ed25519-verify the signature\n    over the canonical core; finally require the (now-authenticated) action to be in the `ACTIONS`\n    allow-list. Mirrors `agents.approvals.verify_approval`. Returns (True, core) or (False, reason).\"\"\"\n    p = payload.payload if hasattr(payload, \"payload\") else payload\n    sig = p.get(\"sig\")\n    device = p.get(\"device\")\n    if not sig or not device:\n        return False, \"missing signature or device\"\n    if device not in authorized:                       # trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n        return False, \"device is not authorized\"\n    core = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != \"sig\"}\n    if not verify_one(device, envelope_message(core), sig):\n        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n    if core.get(\"action\") not in ACTIONS:              # allow-list the authenticated action (fail-closed)\n        return False, f\"unknown action: {core.get('action')!r}\"\n    return True, core\n\n\ndef record_receipt(store: SpineStore, core: dict) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Append the append-only consumption receipt. Carries only the routing fields — never `args`\n    (which may hold a subject) and never the signature; the record is auto-tier (an A0 event).\"\"\"\n    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n                        payload={\"signal\": RECEIPT_SIGNAL, \"device\": core[\"device\"],\n                                 \"action\": core[\"action\"], \"nonce\": core[\"nonce\"],\n                                 \"ts\": core[\"ts\"], \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n\n\ndef device_nonce_highwater(store: SpineStore, device_pubkey: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"The highest receipted nonce for this device (0 if none). Non-int nonces are tolerated (skipped).\"\"\"\n    hi = 0\n    for r in store.iter_records():\n        p = r.payload\n        if p.get(\"signal\") == RECEIPT_SIGNAL and p.get(\"device\") == device_pubkey:\n            try:\n                n = int(p.get(\"nonce\"))\n            except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                continue\n            if n > hi:\n                hi = n\n    return hi\n\n\ndef consume(store: SpineStore, payload, authorized: Set[str], *, effectful: bool) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Authenticate, gate replay for effectful requests, receipt, return the core. Raises `ValueError`\n    with the refusal reason on any failure (fail-closed). An effectful request requires a nonce strictly\n    fresher than this device's highwater; a read skips that gate but still receipts (advancing it).\"\"\"\n    ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, authorized)\n    if not ok:\n        raise ValueError(core)\n    if effectful and int(core[\"nonce\"]) <= device_nonce_highwater(store, core[\"device\"]):\n        raise ValueError(\"replay: nonce not fresh\")\n    record_receipt(store, core)\n    return core\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":805,"cache_read_input_tokens":52641,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":805,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdAPo8LLSAUGu1UAyMHaA","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"3b2c63d7-9159-4428-b926-b9f1adfa6ee5","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:32:33.286Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae3f64939885fb2f2","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

sign_envelope(device, build_core(device.public_key_b64, action, {}, nonce, 1700000000 + nonce))\n\n    # nonce=1 succeeds\n    core1 = consume(s, env(\"relay\", 1), authorized, effectful=True)\n    assert core1[\"nonce\"] == 1 and device_nonce_highwater(s, device.public_key_b64) == 1\n\n    # a SECOND nonce=1 (a replay) is refused\n    try:\n        consume(s, env(\"relay\", 1), authorized, == 2\n\n\ndef test_reads_skip_freshness_but_still_receipt():\n    s = _store()\n    device, authorized = _authorized_device(s)\n    read = sign_envelope(device, build_core(device.public_key_b64,
